description: A granite-answer/1 answer (https://github.com/riteshpakala/Granite/blob/main/Schema/granite-agent-answer.schema.json): `paths`, `made` against `expected`, `problems`, `payloads`, beside the package's own keys. Craft measures `made` against `expected` per call, and draws each payload by its `schema`.

then.description: a time series: the file, named `*.timeseries.json`, validates against https://github.com/rao-craft/StoicAgent/blob/main/Schema/timeseries.schema.json

schema.description: a registered sub-standard Craft draws, or one it shows as a file
